cards.meaning: estimate, forecast; a guess backed by data about a figure expected to happen
cards.example: Ayon sa pagtaya ng mga ekonomista, aabot sa 6.5 porsiyento ang inflation ngayong Setyembre.
cards.exampleMeaning: According to economists' estimates, inflation will reach 6.5 percent this September.
cards.note: Pormal at neutral ang gamit sa balita at negosyo: pagtaya ng mga ekonomista, pagtaya ng BSP. Sa araw-araw na usapan, mas natural ang 'hula' o 'tantiya.' Huwag ipagkamali sa 'taya' sa pagsusugal; konteksto ang nagtatakda ng kahulugan.
cards.tiesTo: Economists' 6.5% September inflation estimate and S&P's call for another BSP hike

cards.meaning: looming; portending something bad that has not yet happened
cards.example: Nagbabadya ang panibagong pagtaas ng presyo ng gasolina sa susunod na linggo.
cards.exampleMeaning: Another rise in gasoline prices is looming next week.
cards.note: Mas mabigat at mas pampanitikan kaysa 'paparating'; may dalang pangamba at halos laging masama ang kasunod (bagyo, krisis, mataas na presyo). Angkop sa pagbabalita.
cards.tiesTo: Pump-price hikes (diesel +P8.82/L) and higher September inflation

cards.meaning: to roll out / introduce a policy, measure or regulation officially
cards.example: 国务院表示，将出台一揽子政策稳定经济。
cards.examplePinyin: Guówùyuàn biǎoshì, jiāng chūtái yī lǎn zi zhèngcè wěndìng jīngjì.
cards.exampleMeaning: The State Council said it will roll out a package of policies to stabilize the economy.
cards.note: 书面语/formal, standard in official announcements. Typical objects: 政策、措施、规定. Not for products (use 推出/发布). Near-synonym contrast: 制定 (zhìdìng) is drafting/formulating; 出台 is the moment it goes public and takes effect.
cards.tiesTo: State Council's promised package of additional policies and ~500bn yuan of extra local bond quotas

cards.meaning: at the same time … (one subject doing two actions in parallel)
cards.example: 地方政府一边缩减开支，一边努力稳住经济。
cards.examplePinyin: Dìfāng zhèngfǔ yìbiān suōjiǎn kāizhī, yìbiān nǔlì wěnzhù jīngjì.
cards.exampleMeaning: Local governments are cutting spending while also trying to keep the economy steady.
cards.note: 口语/neutral connective pair (HSK 4). Links two simultaneous actions of the same subject. Contrast with 同时 (tóngshí), more formal/abstract and able to link two whole situations. In news, gives a vivid, slightly critical edge to a government doing two things at once.
cards.tiesTo: Beijing stabilizing property while safeguarding jobs, with local governments squeezed between the two
